ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (39) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form).

«Общение с людьми» (obshchenie s lyud'mi, 'association with people') is rendered 'dealings with people' in both the heading thought and the closing italic thought, so that the frame matches. «Познай самого себя» (poznay samogo sebya) is plain 'Know yourself', not the archaic 'Know thyself', and generic «человек» (chelovek, 'person') keeps 'he/him' where the website draft had 'they/them'.
